description: This file defines the 'Language' class within the OpenCart system library module. The class provides methods for managing language translation strings, including loading language files, retrieving, setting, and listing translation keys, as well as handling multiple language paths.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Manages language translation strings, supporting loading from files, retrieving, setting, and managing translation data within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Language object with a language code.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a namespace to directory path mappings for language files.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a translation string by key, returning the key itself if not set.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a translation string for a specific key.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all translation data, optionally filtered by a prefix.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language strings from a specified file, with optional prefix and code, caching loaded results.
